description: This source file defines the CameraCaptureService actor in Swift, which provides functionalities for listing camera devices, capturing photos (snap), and recording videos (clip) with detailed error handling and device management. It interacts with AVFoundation frameworks for camera access and media processing, and includes utility classes for photo and video capture delegation.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Handles the photo capture callback, returning photo data or errors upon completion.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Handles the video recording completion callback, providing the saved file URL or errors.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo with specified parameters such as facing, maxWidth, quality, deviceId, and delay.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip with specified parameters such as facing, duration, audio inclusion, deviceId, and output path.
